theme: Skia m151 and managed perf ports
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed C#.
highlights_body: Ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion, PMColor premultiplication, and HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing to allocation-free managed code, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries with new exception handling, and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m151, including several rounds of upstream bug-fix merges and a fix restoring SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to resolve a CPU raster regression.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: Fixes a native resource leak when creating an SKImage from encoded data with an explicit subset rectangle.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job, and rebuilds the emsdk libraries with the new exnref exception-handling model to catch regressions earlier.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the Skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition, added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries, and added the cross-backend golden-image visual regression test harness

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opens the 4.151.0 line by updating Skia to milestone m151 and bumping the Skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 ports SKShaper glyph reads, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 to allocation-free managed code, restores the legacy shader context to fix a CPU raster regression, and merges further upstream m151 fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion and single-value PMColor premultiplication to managed math, adds the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries and exception-handling test coverage, fixes the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak, and merges the final round of upstream m151 bug fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse.
